standard: shampoo-classification-v1.6.1 candidate (lane-a scrubbed copy); not a locked policy id

formulaBlock.normalization: ID-2: no synonym or split entries; 18 normalized entries; normalized positions

cleansingStrength.rationale: moderate by C1 (settled core): defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 with prominent buffers Cocamidopropyl Hydroxysultaine @3 and Coco-Glucoside @5, no reinforcing strong anionic. Laureth-2 @12 is a thickener (not cleansing).

conditioningLevel.rationale: moderate: one meaningful system (prominent cationic Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @10) with light routes Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein @6 and Glycerin @9; no silicone, no payload lipid, no pearlizer, so C2 and high are not available. Counter-signal: guar is after Biotin @7 (typically sub-1 %), so slip may be light; neighbor low.

reset: strong anionic ether Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2

wLineRecord.note: Biotin @7: (i) surfactants before; (ii) between @8 and @12 no cleansing surfactant, no alkanolamide-type thickener (Laureth-2 is not one), no pearlizing wax. No payload_lipid in the formula.

weightPotential.counterevidence: Two deposition families (cationic guar, hydrolyzed protein).
weightPotential.whyThisBand: The only depositing routes are one cationic guar listed after the W-line (after Biotin, a typical sub-1 % active) and a hydrolyzed protein of low persistence, facing an effective SLES/sultaine/glucoside chassis.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: W2: one light polymer after a sub-1 % marker plus a low-persistence hydrolyzed protein, facing moderate reset, keeps combined residue below noticeable; there is no silicone, no lipid and no pearlizer. moderate is the realistic neighbor if the guar is dosed higher than its position suggests.
weightPotential.rationale: low: light, low-persistence deposition vs effective reset, W2 reason named (6.6, W2).

careDirection.limitation: formula-only; one protein token is not a repair cluster

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Biotin @7 and rice extract @8 are marketing-type actives, not routes.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind pass: claim direction null; light formula compatible with volume or general; provisional general.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered; no claims visible.

usageRole.rationale: provisional regular; frequent possible with U2 wording (cleansing moderate); no dandruff active.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: provisional not_targeted (no positioning visible). CSA formula half met by prominent humectant route Glycerin @9; no prominent E4 comfort route (an S-SENSITIVE gate would fail).

dandruffSupport.rationale: not_supported: complete formula without a recognized dandruff active.

surfactantClasses.c4: defining SLES @2; buffers @3, @5; no reinforcing route

uncertainties: conditioningLevel moderate vs low and weightPotential low vs moderate both rest on the unknown guar amount.
